description: This file implements the IBM DB2 Native Client driver for the ADOdb database abstraction layer in PHP. It contains class definitions for database connection handling (ADODB_db2) and recordset operations (ADORecordSet_db2), along with methods for schema inspection, query execution, transaction management, and stored procedure support specific to DB2.

classes.name: ADODB_db2
classes.description: Class for handling IBM DB2 database connections, schema queries, transaction control, and command execution tailored to DB2-specific SQL syntax and features.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_db2
classes.description: Class representing recordsets fetched from DB2 database queries, with methods for row navigation, field retrieval, and result set management.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the DB2 database using provided DSN, username, password, and database name.

methods.name: createSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence object in the database for generating unique IDs.

methods.name: dropSequence
methods.description: Drops an existing sequence object from the database.

methods.name: selectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with optional limit and offset for paginated retrieval.

methods.name: metaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a specified table.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key relationships for a specified table.

methods.name: metaTables
methods.description: Lists all tables in the current database/schema, optionally filtered by type, schema, and mask.

methods.name: metaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a specified table.

methods.name: metaProcedures
methods.description: Lists stored procedures and functions available in the current database/schema.

methods.name: metaDatabases
methods.description: Returns the name of the current database.

methods.name: dbTimeStamp
methods.description: Formats a timestamp value into a DB2-compatible date/time string.

methods.name: sqlDate
methods.description: Generates a SQL expression to format date/time fields according to the given format.

methods.name: serverInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the DB2 server version and fixpack.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from the connection.

methods.name: errorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error code from the connection.

methods.name: beginTrans
methods.description: Begins a new database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: prepareSp
methods.description: Prepares a stored procedure call, validating procedure existence and parameters.

methods.name: executeStoredProcedure
methods.description: Executes a prepared stored procedure with bound parameters.

methods.name: parameter
methods.description: Binds a PHP variable as a parameter to a stored procedure or prepared statement.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares a SQL statement for execution (non-stored-procedure).

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query or statement, handling prepared statements, stored procedures, or direct execution.

methods.name: updateBlob
methods.description: Updates a BLOB field in the database, possibly initializing via null insertment.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last operation.
